category.label: interpreting verbs
category.description: Verbs that interpret the subject instead of naming what it does.

source: avoid-ai-writing by Conor Bronsdon (MIT) and Ryan Yannelli's house rules
notes: State the fact instead of interpreting it.

patterns.show: `plays a key role`, `plays a vital role`, `plays a critical role`, `plays a central role`, `plays a significant role`, `plays an important role`
